en.topic_title: 5 months, 3 weeks jail for senior police officer who molested colleague at force HQ
en.topic_summary:
A senior police superintendent has received a prison sentence of five months and three weeks after being found guilty of indecently assaulting a female subordinate on three occasions in 2024, including at a work party.



Senior Superintendent of Police Ian Chow received his sentence at the West Kowloon Magistrates’ Courts on Friday. His legal team announced his intention to appeal, and Chow was released on bail in the interim.



West Kowloon Law Courts Building. File photo: Kelly Ho/HKFP
